title: I've never been this excited for a Broadway show! @The Lost Boys: A N...
transcript: I think I just discovered my new favorite broadway show. I was in the room for the exclusive sneak peek of the lost boys, a new musical, and it actually left me speechless. Based on the cult classic warner brothers film, the lost boys is bringing the story to life on broadway in a way that is going to make you lose your mind. And the team behind the musical is that you have tony award winner michael arden directing. Music by indie pop rock band the rescue and co produced by patrick wilson. Yes! Of the conjuring. The show is going to transport you to santa carla, california, where, yes, there is a vampire rock band, but there is also a story about a family, brotherhood, love, and the search for belonging. Told by a cast of broadway legends like john bean, paul alexander nolan, and an incredible group of broadway debuts. I'll stay by your side for all my days till we make it through. Like, are you kidding? The lost boys begins previews march twenty seventh on broadway at the palace theater. And if the sneak peek left me this goofed and gagged, then I can't wait to see what the full show will do to me.
reasoning: The creator expresses extreme enthusiasm, calling it their 'new favorite Broadway show' and saying it 'left me speechless' and made them 'goofed and gagged.' This is clearly a strong recommendation with passionate language throughout.
